associations.rationale: The type is an intermediate counting identity equating length-n path cardinalities with entries of the nth adjacency-matrix power; it does not state the basis or Hilbert-series claim.
The type gives the resulting finrank as the total number of length-n paths, but does not directly exhibit those paths as a basis or state the resolvent Hilbert series.
The type states the resolvent Hilbert-series formula, but it does not itself exhibit length-n paths as a basis of the degree-n piece, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
The type identifies the matrix inverse with an auxiliary resolvent, an intermediate identity used for the Hilbert-series calculation rather than the source claim itself.
The displayed type only constructs the path-algebra degree piece as a submodule and does not state its basis or Hilbert series.
